description: A deeply conversational task teaching preschoolers how to count animals.

engage.speech_start: This is a dog. . . . This is a cat. . . . This is a fish. . . . And you can see this is a butterfly, . . and a bird! . . . Wow!
engage.speech_middle: Let's count. . One. . Two. . Three. . Four. . Five.
engage.speech_end: Again, let's count. . One. . Two. . Three. . Four. . Five. . . Say OK if you are done.
